column1: # learning's engraving, MEASURED at wave LD5 (2026-08-19) and READ before freezing.
# ⚠ ASKED AND FAILED ARE THE LOAD-BEARING ROWS. The Texinfo package CATCHES a renderer that
# throws and shows the snippet's source instead, so "the manual rendered" is compatible with
# every engraving having failed -- and the HTML warning profile cannot see the difference
# (MEASURED at wave LD3: the Notation Reference produced an IDENTICAL 13-warning profile
# with 114, 28 and 12 failures). Freezing what was ASKED FOR as well as what came back also
# catches the opposite failure, where a search path stops resolving and the render quietly
# stops asking.
# ⚠ FAILED 0. All six engraving manuals of wave LD5 are FAILED 0, which is worth saying
# beside the Notation Reference's twelve: every failure that manual carries is in an
# appendix built from the port's own GENERATED bytes, and none of it is corpus prose.
# ⚠ ALSO UNCHANGED BY THE PDF, and that is itself a result. Both formats come out of ONE
# pass over the Texinfo source; rendering them separately would engrave every snippet once
# per format -- the coordinator dedupes only WITHIN a render -- and every number below would
# double. The fence for that is not this file (re-freezing would simply record the doubled
# numbers) but every_engraving_reached_the_document_as_a_picture, where one count comes from
# the DOCUMENT and the other from the ENGRAVER.
# DOCUMENT_IMAGES is engravings PLUS the pictures an @image named -- here 253 engravings and the 5 Frescobaldi screenshots.
